exposure: Women with other indications for oocyte donation
cohort: 298 singleton pregnancies in Sweden (76 oocyte donation, 149 spontaneous conception, 63 non-donor IVF)
finding: The study found that infants conceived through oocyte donation in Sweden had higher odds of being born prematurely and having lower mean birthweight compared to non-donor infants.
mod_finding: Infants conceived through oocyte donation had higher odds of premature delivery compared to spontaneously conceived infants.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight was lower in the oocyte donation group compared to the autologous oocyte group (p=0.013)
